exposure: Increased uric acid in pregnancy-induced hypertension
cohort: The study included 106 patients with pregnancy-induced hypertension, divided into Group-A with raised uric acid and Group-B with normal uric acid.
finding: Raised uric acid in patients with pregnancy-induced hypertension is associated with adverse perinatal outcomes in neonates.
mod_finding: Raised uric acid was associated with a higher cesarean mode of delivery.
